item.title: Mobile App
item.description:
Mobile App Project

This mobile application helps users manage their daily tasks efficiently.

Overview

The app provides a clean, intuitive interface for task management with features like:

  • Task creation and editing
  • Priority levels
  • Due date reminders
  • Progress tracking

Technical Details

  • Built with React Native for cross-platform compatibility
  • Firebase backend for real-time synchronization
  • Redux for state management
  • Push notifications for reminders

item.title: Data Analytics Dashboard
item.description:
Data Analytics Dashboard

A comprehensive dashboard for data visualization and analysis.

Project Goals

  • Visualize large datasets
  • Provide interactive charts
  • Real-time data updates
  • Export capabilities

Implementation

The dashboard was built using:

  • Python for data processing
  • D3.js for interactive visualizations
  • PostgreSQL for data storage
  • Flask for the web framework

Results

The dashboard successfully processes over 1M data points and provides real-time insights to stakeholders.
